html:
The Rozvi Empire was a Shona state founded by Changamire Dombo in the late 17th century, which drove the Portuguese from the Zimbabwe plateau and ruled much of it until the 1830s.

Dombo defeated a Portuguese force at Maungwe in 1684 and in 1693 destroyed their trading fairs on the plateau, ending their hopes of taking its gold. The Rozvi then took over the lands of Torwa in the southwest and much of the old Mutapa domain.

The empire traded gold and ivory through the Portuguese at the Zambezi fairs, without letting them in. It was broken in the 1830s by Nguni invaders fleeing the wars of the Mfecane, among them the Ndebele of Mzilikazi.
sum: The Rozvi Empire was a Shona state founded by Changamire Dombo in the late 17th century, which drove the Portuguese from the Zimbabwe plateau and ruled much of it until the 1830s.
